body: cli/ is its own module (github.com/ubgo/dotenv/cli) so cobra and x/term stay out of the library's dependency graph. A separate repo (ubgo/dotenvctl) was rejected for now: one repo keeps a library change and the flag that uses it in one commit; it can be extracted later if an umbrella CLI appears. The main package sits at cli/cmd/dotenvctl so go install names the binary dotenvctl. The verbs package is dotenvcmd/ (exported, embeddable).
title: dotenvctl lives in a nested Go module cli/ in the same repo
